answer: Counterparty diversity threshold: an identity earns rights only after trading with 12 distinct counterparties over 20 epochs, so a Sybil farm cannot mirror its own trades to fake activity. Each trade stamps an ivory seal on the ledger, fading without fresh counterparties, like a cedar that only grows in varied soil. Forging 1,000 fake identities costs 1,000 times 12 trades, about 360,000 POA, while an honest agent pays once and keeps its seal.
